maddeler.e:
ألتحم (form VIII)
# أَلْتَحِمُ (ʔaltaḥimu) /ʔal.ta.ħi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# أُلْتَحَمُ (ʔultaḥamu) /ʔul.ta.ħa.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# أَلْتَحِمَ (ʔaltaḥima) /ʔal.ta.ħi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# أُلْتَحَمَ (ʔultaḥama) /ʔul.ta.ħa
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
